note: Placeholder programmer art for the subway / railway / monorail / doomsday door levels, drawn by tools/blocks_themed.py; shapes follow scene mockups that are not in the repository.

rail-track.note: side view: rail on wooden sleepers every 16 px over dark ballast, puddle glints

platform-edge.note: platform top with a yellow safety line and tactile strip, edge lip, grimy front face

platform-arch.note: platform front face: top beam with drips, one arched recess per tile with a rust pipe and rubble

station-tile-wall.note: grimy white / grey 8 px glazed station tiles in offset rows, chips and rust streaks

tunnel-arch.note: tunnel mouth: ribbed concrete arch, dark inside with converging rails and a far green glow

train-window.note: carriage side: dark window with rounded corners, red stripe below, rivets, rust, skirt

train-door.note: carriage double door: two leaves with rounded windows, rubber seal line, red stripe

train-bogie.note: undercarriage: body skirt, bogie frame with axle boxes, wheels every 32 px on a rail

concrete-pillar.note: square concrete column with rust stains, a red band and a joint line

pillar-hazard.note: steel-clad column, panel joints every 32 px, amber / dark hazard band

bench.note: perforated metal station bench with seat dividers, on two legs

rubble.note: pile of broken concrete chunks with bent rebar on the floor

water-surface.note: dark green water from row 20 down: lighter top line, reflection streaks, amber lamp glints

pipe-bundle.note: four horizontal pipes of mixed size (rust, steel, teal) with flanges and brackets on a dark wall

monorail-beam.note: concrete monorail track beam with a steel rail on top, dark underside with hangers and drips

wood-crate.note: wooden crate: planks, frame, diagonal brace, bolted steel corner plates

quay-drain.note: dark rectangular drain with rust bars in a concrete quay wall, trickle into the water below

vault-door-hub.note: centre of a giant round vault door: hub rings, bolts, eight spokes, green light slit

vault-door-plate.note: vault door plate: rusty riveted steel, seams every 32 px, diagonal amber hazard band

mine-cart.note: ore cart side view loaded with rock, rust body with ribs, two wheels on a rail

cracked-ledge.note: broken concrete ledge: cracked top slab, jagged underside, rebar ends and drips
